title: Two normalized charts for prime-power unimodular row classes
statement: Let p and a be natural numbers with p prime and 0 < a. Put R = ℤ/p^aℤ and U = {(r,s) ∈ R² | ∃ x,y ∈ R, xr + ys = 1}. Define v ∼ w to mean that there exists a unit u of R with uv₁ = w₁ and uv₂ = w₂. There exists an equivalence between Quot(∼) and the disjoint sum R ⊕ {z ∈ R | z is not a unit}.
lean_statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), p.Prime → 0 < a → let R := ZMod (p ^ a); Nonempty ((Quot (fun v w : {v : R × R // ∃ x y : R, x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : Rˣ, (u : R) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : R) * v.1.2 = w.1.2)) ≃ (R ⊕ {z : R // ¬ IsUnit z}))
